description:
Utility for mass-downloading LRC synced lyrics for your offline music library

Utility for mass-downloading LRC synced lyrics for your offline music library. LRCGET will scan every files in your chosen directory for music files, then and try to download lyrics to a LRC files having the same name and save them to the same directory as your music files.
Changelog:
- Switched to LRCLIB's v2 search API for faster, lighter searches, with automatic fallback to v1 for older LRCLIB instances.
- Added "Word Synced" badges to lyrics search results, My LRCLIB results, and the library track list.
